display.title: Episode 34: The Two Brothers (Erev Tisha B'Av)
display.summary_short: On the eve of Tisha B'Av, Uncle Yossi teaches the soul's 'diet' of Torah, Avodah and Gemilus Chasadim and tells why Hashem chose the mountain of two loving brothers for the Beis HaMikdash.
display.summary_long: A summer show broadcast two days before Tisha B'Av 5742. Uncle Yossi explains that just as the body needs a healthy diet, the neshama needs three things: Torah, which is light and shows us right from wrong; Avodah, davening to Hashem, who alone can grant every request; and Gemilus Chasadim, acts of kindness, above all tzedakah, which refines the giver. A young guest in Studio 604 leads the Shema. Story time tells of two brothers, Reuven and Shimon, who each secretly carry wheat over the mountain at night to help the other, meet at the top and embrace; Hashem chooses that very mountain, Har HaMoriah, for the Beis HaMikdash. Uncle Yossi explains that the Beis HaMikdash was destroyed because of baseless hatred and will be rebuilt through Ahavas Yisroel. He then speaks about the power of music, from the Levi'im in the Beis HaMikdash to the song we will sing when Moshiach comes, and introduces the ancient tune of Eicha, closing with the verse Hashiveinu.
display.lesson: Feed your soul with Torah, davening and kindness, and love every Jew like a brother: Ahavas Yisroel is what will rebuild the Beis HaMikdash.

date.note: 'Tomorrow is Erev Tisha B'Av'; Tisha B'Av 5742 fell on Thursday 29 July, so this Tuesday show is 7 Av. Matches the weekly estimate.

advisories.note: Tisha B'Av and the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash, explained gently with hope for the Geulah.

'Hinei lo yanum v'lo yishan Shomer Yisroel.'
'Az yashir Moshe': the future song of the Geulah.
